Subject: Forecast category definitions — commit / best-case / pipeline clarity

Hi team,

Quick note to get a short working session on the calendar: were seeing inconsistent stage mappings across a handful of enterprise deals (examples attached) which is producing noisy commit numbers in the month-end forecast. Id like to run a 30-minute "Commit Lab" where we: 
- align on precise definitions for Commit / Best Case / Pipeline,
- walk three live deal examples (one ACME deal included), and
- share a one-page checklist sales can use before moving a deal to Commit.

Proposed times: Dec 3, 11:00–11:30 PT or Dec 4, 10:00–10:30 PT. Please reply with the slot that works.

Prep (short): review the attached playbook draft (redwood_forecast_playbook_draft.pdf) and the pipeline mapping spreadsheet I exported from HubSpot. If you can, add one row to the spreadsheet with the most recent stage for your top deals so we can use them as examples.

Goals: reduce forecast churn by making the definitions operational (explicit checklist items), and document the HubSpot stage -> Forecast Category mapping so ops can enforce validation rules.

Thanks — see attachment and links below.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_forecast_playbook_draft.pdf (draft), pipeline-mapping.xlsx (export)
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_drive_link

Karthik — I can do Dec 3 at 11:00 PT. Ill run the examples and bring three deals from my book: one clearly Commit, one Best Case edge-case, and one that should stay Pipeline. I added notes to redwood_forecast_playbook_draft.pdf (minor language suggestions) and put my top-3 deals in the spreadsheet.

Two quick asks for the session:
1) Can we include a short checklist slide that sales reps can screenshot and keep in their HubSpot record?
2) If we decide to change a stage mapping, can ops push a validation rule so reps get a prompt?

Short reply below for the group — Ill join and Ill prepare the slide.

— Marissa
Director, Mid-Market Sales
